input.quote: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
input.rationale: Section 14.10 restricts only the Customer: we need IBM's consent to assign, while IBM is left free to assign (indeed § 14.2 and § 14.18 contemplate IBM assignees) including potentially to a competitor of ours. The existing carve-out covers a successor by merger, consolidation or acquisition but omits assignment to our affiliates and a sale of all or substantially all assets, both of which our playbook requires. No change-of-control termination or re-pricing right exists anywhere in the Agreement (§ 3.3 is a standard mutual breach termination), so no deletion is needed there. The redline makes the consent restriction mutual, adds the affiliate/asset-sale carve-out for us, and bars IBM from assigning to a Customer competitor without consent.

proposal.summary: Make assignment restriction mutual, add affiliate/asset-sale carve-out for Customer, and bar assignment by IBM to a Customer competitor.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the assignment restriction mutual and added a carve-out so we may assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets without consent, and so IBM may not assign to one of our competitors. Our playbook does not accept a one-sided restriction that binds only the Customer; if helpful, we can accept a mutual right to assign to successors on written notice with consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld.

ops.oldText: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld.
ops.newText: Neither party will assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of the other party, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and IBM will not assign this Agreement to a competitor of Customer without Customer's prior written consent.

ops.oldText: Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
ops.newText: Customer may assign this Agreement, without IBM's consent, to any entity that controls, is controlled by or is under common control with Customer, or to a successor organization by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets.

ops.oldText: In any permitted assignment, Customer will remain liable for its obligations hereunder.
ops.newText: In any permitted assignment, the assigning party will remain liable for its obligations hereunder.
